target_claim: Latent weekly fan-share distributions reproduce reported eliminations with quantified, nonuniform uncertainty.

leakage_risks: results and placement only define validation constraints
data_audit.missingness_notes: Judge-4 and late-season missingness are structural; zero scores after elimination are inactive.

baseline.name: uniform minimum-adjustment
baseline.reason: transparent least-information reference that can expose infeasible weeks
baseline.validation: weekly elimination compatibility and simplex violation

candidates.name: maximum-entropy constrained votes
candidates.formulation: For each week maximize -sum_i v_i log(v_i) subject to v on the simplex and the reported eliminated contestant having a non-greater combined score than every survivor.
assumptions: one weekly vote share vector applies to all rule comparisons
parameter_sources: judge scores and elimination labels from DATA-PROCESSED-C
validation_plan: hold out seasons 29-34 for stress reporting
refutation_evidence: less than 90% of evaluable weeks feasible
candidates.decision_reason: Uses the least additional information while satisfying observed outcomes and exposes uncertainty rather than inventing labels.

candidates.name: quadratic minimum-deviation votes
candidates.formulation: Minimize sum_i (v_i-1/n)^2 under the same weekly simplex and elimination constraints.
assumptions: uniform support is a defensible neutral center
refutation_evidence: infeasible in any week feasible for primary
candidates.decision_reason: Convex, interpretable, and executable if entropy optimization has numerical issues.

candidates.name: supervised fan-vote neural network
candidates.formulation: Fit a nonlinear predictor of observed fan-vote share from contestant attributes and scores.
validation_plan: would require labeled out-of-sample fan votes
rejection_evidence: official PDF describes fan votes as unknown and secret
candidates.decision_reason: The official data do not contain fan votes, so supervised training would manufacture the target.

stop_conditions: less than 90% of evaluable weeks reconstructable
unresolved constraint convention changes headline results
